outlook.statement: The Board remains focused on stabilising the Company's financial position, improving its operating performance and identifying suitable opportunities that may contribute to sustainable growth and long-term value creation for stakeholders.

The Company remains cautiously optimistic about its future prospects. The management intends to focus on strengthening the existing operations of the Company while simultaneously evaluating new business opportunities that are commercially viable and capable of contributing to sustainable growth.
